title: Traditional German Kazandibi Milk Pudding
description: A creamy, nutty, and sweet German dessert based on the Turkish kazandibi recipe, topped with a layer of caramelized nuts.
instructions: Mix the milk, kazandibi, and nutty in a bowl, whisking until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until set.
Caramelize the nutty by cooking it in a pan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Top the pudding with the caramelized nutty.
